name: Ship_UpdateShipAI
comment: NovaAi_UpdateShipAI: three-arm dispatcher mirrors 0x00401000. The entry control-mode 4/0xd arm runs only the state-0x0B hold exits and rejoins at the state machine, so behavior selection is bypassed -- this fixes capture/plunder behavior-3 ships parked in control 4 whose behavior supervisor re-stamped ai_mode_start_time_ms every frame, wedging the mode-4 jump spin-up. The ordinary arm runs Ship_IssueEscortOrders, the disabled auto-guard, and the behavior dispatch (capture-variant selection via zero-based GovernmentByIndex; behavior 0/2/3/4/>4 routing and availability/defense-fleet/mission precedence). Deliberate divergence: the original's bVar6 throttle (g_ai_update_period 0x00591184, graded from the g_avg_frame_tick_scale EMA by Frame_MeasureFrameTiming 0x00432ea0) skips the behavior supervisor and Ship_UpdateShipAiState on non-matching frames and also rolls state 0x13 back to state 0; the port runs maximum cadence (period 1) and does not model either, and the original's second argument that only bypasses the throttle is dropped from the port signature. Also deferred: the 0x2ff player-sentinel early return, g_gameplay_time_frozen early return, top-of-function mission_fleet_slot bookkeeping, availability g_ai_target_refresh_needed refresh, and the sprite arrival-marker animation latches. Known divergence flagged in-code: the disabled auto-guard does not clear defense_fleet_home_stellar_id (TODO(decomp)).

name: Ship_ScanPlayerForContraband

Caller wired: NovaAi_UpdateShipState state-7 player branch (0x00407811), integration-tested, incl. a real NovaTravel_Tick committed-jump suppression test. The licence-nag and g_ai_misc_event_flag omissions are caller-only and live on the 0x00405590 row; no scanner-body gaps.

State-3 intercept taunt is wired. Divergence: per-NPC cargo total is hard-coded 0 (clean-room Ship has no per-ship cargo), so a miner never reaches the full-hold state-2 exit; TODO(decomp).

Intercept taunts run for state 3 and the original state-4 hostile-NPC branch. Government assistance encounter is wired; remaining behavior arms are incomplete.

Tests: "warship behavior reacquires a target from travel states", "warship behavior leaves state 6 once no fighters remain". Remaining: unverified aggression-cadence semantics; no mission-fleet overlay is visible in the decompile.

Destroyed/state-0x16 guards, two-pass nearest player-side (slot 0 or squad_leader==0) engageable-under-cloak search with the 6000^2 (DAT_00575060) first-pass bound and truncated Math_SquaredDistance ranking, then clear-secondary/reset-maneuver, existing-primary revalidation, acquire best (state 4) or fall back to stellar travel (state 1, secondary = defense_fleet_home_stellar_id), and the NPC-with-non-player-leader primary replacement arm. Dispatched from NovaAi_UpdateShipAI when defense_fleet_home_stellar_id != -1. Divergence: the original revalidates the existing primary by indexing ships[0x40] (the exhausted loop counter, one past the 64-ship array -- an out-of-bounds read with no defined value); the port uses the existing primary slot, the evident intent. TODO(decomp(0x00405120)) records this.

Wired ahead of defense/ordinary behavior dispatch; resource-id stellar targets are preserved through the clean-room post-state weapon refresh.

name: Ship_UpdateShipAiState
comment: NovaAi_UpdateShipState: travel/hold/pursuit/escort/disengage/defunct branches plus attack states 3/4, assist state 0xc, boarding state 0xd, and state-0x14 jump-point transitions. State 4 now runs the original valid-target tail (LAB_00406bc2): the carrier-bay launch plus Government_TryTriggerGovtAssistanceEncounter every frame while the ship is not disabled, and the Flags2 0x0002 standoff arm selects mode 7/0xe/5 from the truncated 0.85x (short)max weapon range, halved for a disabled target. State 0xd has no launch call. State 2 and the state-3 attack jump-departure arm honor Ship_CheckSpecialLoadoutCapability via NovaOutfit_HasFastJumpCapability (0x0046d080): class Flags2 0x20 (can jump without slowing down) or an owned/default outfit ModType 0x25 (37, kFastJump). ai_maneuver_timer_ms holds normalized simulation ticks; state 0xe advances position directly at elapsed_ticks * 0.7; state 0x15 now falls through to state 8 in the same pass, immediately restoring the -999 arrival sentinel/control 0x0a as the original does. State 8 normally exits through the Ship_HandleShip reverse-speed reset, with the outer vacant-ship sweep as fallback. NPC jump completion resolves the linked system, consumes fuel, and re-enters through state 0x15; formation offsets and HUD/mission flavor remain deferred. State 0xf is the assist approach on a comm-window Request Assistance target (0x00410c70): keep-away range (10-turn)*30+50 with an is_active gate; state documented as assist/hover rather than pursuer-flee. State 0x10 now splits into control 0x13 (far) / 0x14 (close merge) by the trunc((10.0 - class turn_rate) * 15.0) distance gate against asteroid_pool[0] (inactive target -> mode 1). State-7 escort player branch now calls Ship_ScanPlayerForContraband (0x00401800); the state-7 g_ai_misc_event_flag write and the pers_def_slot==0x3ff shareware/licence nag arm (0x004076dc) remain TODO(decomp): the clean-room build has no shareware/registration state so the nag has no port analog, and g_ai_misc_event_flag's consumer was not traced, so it is left unresolved rather than marked redundant.

name: Ship_ApplyShipAiControls
comment: NovaAi_ApplyControls: travel modes 1/2/3 faithful; combat modes 5/6/7/8/9/0xb/0xc/0xe/0xf/0x10/0x11/0x12/0x13/0x14/0x16 port the ground-truth movement (alignment gates, break-off/evasive-boost transitions, relative-velocity brake ladders, velocity-match copy, formation/scripted creeps, escort follow), with mode-5 steering-away quirk (Math_BearingFromPointToPoint target->ship arg order) confirmed from disassembly. Modes 6/7/0xe aim with the +0xc8da last-lead-fired bank: mode 6 leads with the active bank only for weapon modes {-1,6} and otherwise falls back to +0xc8da or the straight bearing; mode 7 aims predictively with the active bank when +0xc8da is set, else the straight bearing; mode 0xe's fast branch leads with +0xc8da when set, else reverses the velocity bearing. Ship_AimWeaponPredictive (NovaAi_AimWeaponPredictive) itself returns the straight bearing for -1/non-lead ids. Mode 4 accumulates normalized frame time and completes the original NPC departure lifecycle against the shared 60 Hz tick clock (GameState.tick_60hz) after NovaTravel_JumpSequenceDuration60Hz() (Ghidra Stellar_GetJumpSequenceDuration60Hz 0x0046efb0, 364 ticks = ~6.07 s); visible departure motion is handled by NovaShip_IntegrateNpcMovement (Ghidra Ship_HandleShip 0x00433050); class duration multiplier now scales the mode-4 deadline (NovaTravel_JumpSequenceDuration60Hz(state) / cls->jump_duration_multiplier; stock Shuttle 1.3 -> ~4.7 s). Mode 4 hold timer ramped; mode 0xd's raw +1 formation-release counter is time-adjusted by elapsed_ticks/0.63 while retaining the original pre-increment >30 release test; mode 10 uses the exact -50/-1.165 arrival-slowdown commands and preserves an already-negative ai_desired_speed (mode 0 does not clobber it), so state-15 gate-emergence ships exit at -30/-15 px/tick rather than reseeding -50. The entry prologue also syncs ai_desired_heading_deg to the truncated current heading every frame (matches the unconditional 0x00408150 prologue store), so unsteered modes 0/10 hold heading exactly and arrival glides fly straight instead of wheeling toward a stale steering target. Weapon-bank selects, formation offsets, carrier-bay launches, freeflight anchors, the +0xBD brake-to-boost producer remains deferred (TODO(decomp)); weapon-bank selects for modes 5/6/7/0x10/0x11/0x12/0xe/0x14/0x16 are wired to the NovaAi_Select* selectors (0x0040ce00/0x0040d220/0x0040d470/0x0040d910/0x0040d7e0); mode 6 additionally makes the original's unconditional Weapon_FireTurretAtTarget call at 0x00409163 (after the aim block, before the turn+15 gate), which the port had dropped so turret-only mode-6 hulls never armed a bank, with point-defense auto-select (0x0043a310), inbound-threat gating (0x004221d0), formation offsets, freeflight anchors, and the +0xBD latch still deferred; carrier-bay launch/recovery (NovaShip_LaunchShipFromCarrierBay at the mode-0xe tail + NovaShip_RecoverCarriedShipToBay at the mode-8 dock arm, see ship_spawn.cpp). Formation-offset arms: modes 5/6/7/0xb call Ship_MoveShipTowardFormationOffset + leader glow copy where the original does; mode 0xd released-hold arm and mode 0xc no-anchor else arm (all snap=0); mode-0xf within-3px resolution ported (boarding latch + 100..179-tick pause arm for the capture supervisor handoff, assist-repair +1.0-armor loop in state 0xf). Mode-0x14 now lead-aims the scripted asteroid with NovaAi_AimWeaponLeadVelocity (0x0043b8c0), which shares AimWeaponInterceptBearing with the predictive path and preserves the original's mode-6 exclusion (a rocket returns the straight bearing). Call-site fidelity is now exact: the refresh runs only in the five original mode arms -- mode 0 (0x00408674, unconditional, split from 0x17) plus the disabled/target-gated modes 1 (0x0040847d), 9 (0x0040ae2f), 0xb (0x0040acf1) and 0xc (0x0040b4bc) -- matching the guards; the former unconditional post-state call in NovaAi_UpdateShipAI (which double-fired modes 1/9/0xb/0xc and spuriously fired every other mode) is removed. Remaining gaps are the +0xBD brake-to-boost latch, player combat-rating gate, carrier-bay launch and formation-offset mirroring.

Missing target classes are rejected with a TODO log (safe divergence from the original's unchecked table access); the original's player-outfit capability memoization is not reproduced (no gameplay effect).

Disasm cross-checked 2026. Benign divergences: SlotInRange / ShipClassFor / Weapon null guards the original omits (safe-fail on malformed data only), and the original's discarded pure Math_SquaredDistance (0x0043b710) call is not reproduced. Covered by tests/weapon_test.cpp (synthetic pair): energy/mass switch, mode-6 blast gate, guided retry, and out-of-range unguided suppression. Point-defense auto-fire is handled independently by the port of 0x0043a310.

Includes retention gate, pers 0x3fe/grudge arms, mission-fleet ShipBehav 0/1 arms, ammo-readiness gate, non-xenophobic behavior<5 ally join, near-player + reputation legal-record ladder (Flags 0x0002 nosy with doubled CrimeTol, 0x0040 never-attacks, allied 1.5x CrimeTol; uses the PLAYER's current system/rep per g_ship_states[0]), inherent-combat-govt 1-in-50 roll (reads the PLAYER's hull class, verified against 0x004629e0/0x004cda50; not distance-gated), xenophobic aggressive scan (player arm also uses the player's system/rep), IFF-scrambler/policy player shield, common tail with MaxOdds perceived-strength filter and squadron-leader Mass preference, nearest-acquirable fallback, and behavior-6 re-selection. TODO(decomp): ShipState fields not on the clean-room struct (field_0x60, weapon_exit_animation_phase, alternate_sprite_cycle_index, weapon_sprite_flash_level, escort pending-sale/upgrade marks, field_0xc924) are not written.

name: Player_RedistributeFleetCargoOverflow
comment: Player_RedistributeFleetCargoOverflow: clears the player's 6 cargo bins and every positive junk count; jettison_all additionally drains abortable active missions carrying cargo (can_abort + carrying_resources + cargo_type != -1 + qty >= 0), shows STR# 0x7d2 0x11c "Mission failed." and fails the slot, else shows entry 0x121 (jettison_all) / 0x122; queues transition sound 4. Walks the player slot + behavior-6 no-mission-fleet escorts and spawns ROUND(share/5) clamped [1,12] freeflight cargo pods per hull. Wired from the Player Info Cargo-page Jettison confirmation (spaceflight.cpp) and the in-flight arm-modifier + slot 0x0f dump. TODO(decomp): DAT_00596d2a clear-transient-sprites latch unmodelled (pods retire by lifetime/system id instead); and the zero-cargo match (tutorial 001: pickup_mode 0, CargoType 73, CargoQty 0) still fails the mission with the 0x11c overlay — verify whether that is a known original oddity or a misread field before diverging.

name: Ship_SpawnFreeflightObjectForShip
comment: NovaFreeflight_SpawnForShip: free-slot scan, ship pos/vel copy, lifetime rand(0x5a)+0xb4 (180-269), system id, rand(0x24) frame seed, spin rate in {-1,0,1}, stock sprite set index 0 (spin 500), backward position offset of round(frame_width/2) and velocity scatter (rand(0x28)+0x1e)/100 +/-rand spread. Called by the jettison pass.

name: Ship_SpawnFreeflightObjectAtPosition
comment: NovaFreeflight_SpawnAtPosition: free-slot scan, explicit position, lifetime rand(200)+300 (300-499), persistent=1, extra/sprite-set from params, radial velocity (rand(0x51)+0x3c)*0.2*0.01. Now called by the asteroid destruction package (YieldType resource-boxes, sprite set (wander_type>>2)+1). Beam-hit / launched-drone callers remain unwired.

name: Shot_SpawnShotFromWeapon
comment: NovaWeapon_SpawnProjectile mirrors the gameplay spawn: owner velocity inheritance, modes 4/7/8 bearing + Ship_AimWeaponPredictive lead overwrite (measured from the muzzle position, 0x0043b740 arg4), player mode-5 0.8 velocity scale, Weapon_SelectTurretQuadrant muzzle placement + negative-spread parallel launch (hull heading radians +/- |spread| consumed as degrees -- original unit mix kept), system-interference confusion roll (x87 FIST truncation toward zero), positive-spread heading jitter, per-mode velocity rules, suicide weapon (ammo -999), fuse sentinel, seek lock_quality seeding. spawn_without_owner now stores the passed owner slot and skips only the owner-relative kinematics/muzzle/turret setup, matching the original so linked submunitions keep owner attribution. Deferred: mode49_roll consumer, mode-9 update callback, fuse ticking. Sprite container selection is modeled: ActiveShot.draws_above_ships is fixed at spawn from weapon mode 4 + owner Flags3 0x0040, selecting the layer-12 mode4_alt container (above ships) vs the mode9/mode1/default containers (below ships). Locked-on/state-0x0D non-lethal impact-variant marking now wired (NovaAiShip_IsShipLockedOnTarget 0x004124F0 + NovaAiShip_IsDisabled).

name: Shot_SpawnLinkedShotsOnImpact
comment: NovaWeapon_SpawnLinkedShotsOnImpact: Bible SubCount/SubType/SubTheta/SubLimit linkage. Gates: range_link_weapon_id != -1 and range_link_gate >= 1; recursion stops when range_link_extra_count > 0 and <= the parent linked_shot_generation. Queues the linked weapon's fire sound spatialized at the impact (spaceflight loop applies the flags_primary 0x10 active-suppression gate). Spawns range_link_gate children through NovaWeapon_SpawnProjectile(spawn_without_owner=true) -- owner is inherited (0x0041fd30 stores the owner slot on ownerless spawns), then pos/vel/heading/generation are overwritten from the parent. Target: parent mode 9 copies the parent target; parent flags_secondary 0x10 (Flags2 nearest-valid-target) retargets via the ported Ship_FindNearestHittableWeaponTarget (0x0046ba30) with the impact target as fallback, re-aiming the heading. SubTheta > 0 randomizes within +/-spread, < 0 fans deterministically across abs(SubTheta)*(SubCount-1) degrees; child mode 6 inherits parent velocity, otherwise polar(heading, linked projectile_speed/100). The expiry callsite in Shot_HandleShot (0x00435830) is wired (range_link_gate > 0 && flags_secondary 0x20 clear), so no deferral remains.

name: Shot_SpawnAreaImpactEffects
comment: Faithful reimplementation in NovaEffects_SpawnAreaImpact: range gate (0..0x3f or 1000..0x427), large-id 1000..1063 inner/outer child bands using the original x87 double scatter constants (DAT_005752b8/.80/.c8/.c0 = 0.04/0.50/0.25/0.16), one-rounding float positions, and explicit x/y/variant RNG order; main effect spawn; conditional impact sound queued with the original slot gate (0..63) and volume 6. Weapon particle bursts are spawned by the caller paths (Weapon_SpawnWeaponImpactParticleBurst 0x004274d0), not this function, so no deferral remains.

name: Shot_SpawnImpactEffectSprite
comment: Reconstructed the 32-slot impact-effect pool allocation and x/y/effect/animation/delay state; renderer sprite binding is handled by SpaceflightView.

name: Shot_SpawnWeaponSmokePuff
comment: Ported (file-local SpawnWeaponSmokePuff): first-dead slot of the 64-entry pool, Weapon Flags1 0x200/0x400 select big/small and 0x800 the persistent (ping-pong) animation, Bible SmokeSet selects the graphics. The renderer loads only the two sequential cicn sets the original creates (resource bases 1000/1008, 8 frames) and draws the variant frame with the original anchor floor(width/2)/floor(height/2); a SmokeSet >= 2 has a null set, so the original's slot scan (which also requires a non-null set) spawns nothing and the port returns before consuming a slot. The original's per-corner tint/distance words reduce to full alpha + ApplyFog. Faithful; unused by all 256 stock Nova weapons.

name: Asteroid_InitSystem
comment: NovaAsteroid_InitSystem: clears the 16-slot pool, spawns asteroid_count records (scatter), and pre-warms all slots over g_viewport_center_x+0x80 / g_viewport_center_y+0x80 (GameState.viewport_center_*, synced each frame by SpaceflightView::SyncGameplayViewport). no_asteroids_latch set for empty systems, cleared for populated ones (the original relies on the departure/landing latch to have deactivated the old field). Re-run on entry, jump arrival and launch.

name: Asteroid_Spawn
comment: NovaAsteroid_Spawn: scatter branch uses [0, viewport_center_x+0x80) x [0, viewport_center_y) centred *0.5 on the player; ring branch radius max(viewport_center_y, 2) with round(radius/2) spread; wander_type masked by ast_types; wander_frame_accumulator seeded from AsteroidDef.mass (stand-in for sprite->num_frames), wander_speed = (rand(0x29)+0x50)*AsteroidDef.spin_rate with 50% sign flip, integrity from AsteroidDef.strength. License-parity toggle DIVERGENCE documented (registration out of scope). TODO(decomp): seed wander_frame_accumulator from the bound sprite's frame count.

name: Asteroid_SpawnRecord
comment: IMPLEMENTED as NovaAsteroid_SpawnRecord (src/game/asteroid.cpp): finds first inactive pool slot, marks active, records wander_type, copies spawn pos, scatters target_vel (rand(200)-100)*0.01, seeds wander_frame_accumulator from AsteroidDef.mass as a stand-in, wander_speed (rand(0x29)+0x50)*AsteroidDef.spin_rate with 50% sign flip (DAT_005752e0 = -1.0), and integrity from AsteroidDef.strength. Signal-accurate against the decomp. Called by ResolveAsteroidDestructionPackage (collision.cpp) for child-asteroid fragmentation; the effect-package/travel-walker spawn paths remain deferred. TODO(decomp) divergence: the original draws the frame seed from the per-type sprite descriptor +0x54 (g_asteroid_sprite_sets[type]->num_frames) rather than AsteroidDef.mass. Pool lives on GameState.asteroid_pool (AsteroidState, 16 x stride 0x24).

name: Stellar_SpawnDefenseFleetShip
comment: NovaStellar_SpawnDefenseFleetShip: spawns one Bible defense-fleet ship from StellarDef.DefenseDude (loader now reads payload +0x1c -> defense_dude_id, rebased; 0x004bd86f/0x004bd9a9). Slot pool 2 with an availability-ignoring retry, stamps defense_fleet_home_stellar_id, forces behavior-3 warship + stellar government, positions at the stellar map point with a random heading and an effective-max-speed initial velocity, calls Ship_SetShipHostileToPlayer, and sets stellar.field_0x47. Tick caller 0x0041d6e0 wired (trickle). Deferred: the travel-destination attack branch (0x00480030) that mounts the first wave and rescales present_ship_count.

name: Ship_IsInboundThreatExceedingDefenses
comment: NovaAi_IsInboundThreatExceedingDefenses preserves the signed-short threat comparison, float-rounded shield+armor sum, binary64 1.05 budget, equality, NaN behavior, and the original x87 excess-precision boundary via an FMA residual check.

name: Ship_TallyInboundWeaponThreat
comment: NovaWeapon_TallyInboundWeaponThreat is wired into full-tick scope 0xb: active-only reset; at most 128 live normal-lock shots; exact target; per-shot half mass+energy truncation; signed-16 wrap. Invalid weapon ids are safely logged/skipped and consumed vector entries are ignored.

name: Ship_SyncJumpStateToSquad
comment: Ported as NovaAi_SyncJumpStateToSquad: jump-prep sync, not retreat. Sole caller is the player's jump-engage hold (0x0044c705), wired in NovaTravel_Tick's kHold branch; escort system transfer happens at arrival adoption (0x0041af90), not here. The sync copies the player's live ai_station_hold_timer + ai_mode_start_time_ms, which the hold seeds at 2.0/0x0044c548 and advances each tick (0x0044c70a).

name: ShipClass_SpawnEscortShipFromClass
comment: Ported as NovaShipClass_SpawnEscortShipFromClass: slot alloc (reserve 8), behavior-6/attach-player defaults, class stock weapon banks, AI-runtime reset, Ship_EnterSquadReturnState. spawn_stellar == -1 copies the player's pos/heading then scatters by a random polar POSITION offset (Math_AddPolarVelocity called on pos_x at disasm 0x00422986, bearing rand(0x168), magnitude 50+rand(0x32) px), not a velocity; velocity stays zero. Divergence: uses std::sin/std::cos instead of the original 0x168-entry angle lookup tables in Math_AddPolarVelocity (0x0043b4a0), so coordinates may differ slightly at float precision.

name: Player_ProcessEscortFleetAtStellar
comment: Ported as Player_ProcessEscortFleetAtStellar, wired into NovaLanded_RunWindow. Faithful sale of escort_pending_sale_mark escorts, upgrades of escort_upgrade_mark escorts, weapon count/secondary-count reset and reseed, refill, summary text, and daily ticks. Divergence: gates on the landed ctx.stellar_id's travel_flags & 8 rather than the player's ai_secondary_target_slot (equivalent clean-room source), and omits the debug-only date trace. Tail calls Player_ProcessEscortPayroll(1).

name: Player_ProcessEscortPayroll
comment: Ported as Player_ProcessEscortPayroll (landed_store.cpp): per-period scan of behavior-6 player-attached non-disabled escorts; mission-fleet exemption (mission_fleet_slot active + fleet_spawn_goal 1); escort_origin_mark gate; upkeep = trunc(base_cost * 0.01) (shared double 0x00575298) charged to player credits or release on shortfall (deactivate, squad_leader -1, behavior 1); STR# 0x7d2 0x12e/0x12f defect message. Unpaid cargo escorts remove their proportional player cargo/junk share before deactivation via 0x00469810. Still omits the defection sound/ease flourish and panel-refresh latch. Called from both dock fleet processing and the post-restoration hyperspace arrival tail; arrival periods use the same maximum fleet travel days as daily world ticks.

name: Player_CollectStellarTribute
comment: Ported as Player_CollectStellarTribute: per-day tribute from available dominated stellars, unified StellarDef +0x2A domination_days increment unless the current stellar carries availability bit 0x20, and stat-cache dirty latch. Called from Mission_TickDailyWorldUpdate. TODO: the negotiation flow that grants domination.

name: Pers_SpawnShipFromPersDef
comment: Faithful function body: full eligibility scan (LinkSyst codes incl. 9999 quirk, derelict exclusion, ActiveOn re-evaluation), active-ship same-name dedup, original single random/forced pick, personality-to-ship layout (class stock weapon loadout plus përs deltas, ShieldMod, Flags2 zero fuel, afterburner latch, aggression cadence clamp), AI-runtime reset, LinkMission target-cache refresh through 0x0043d240, and derelict wreck kinematics/armor. Both ambient and forced call sites use this implementation. Disassembly confirms përs Credits +0x618 is not read by this spawner; it belongs to later interaction/plunder behavior.

name: Player_ReplaceShipWithCapturedHull
comment: Faithful reconstruction: preserves player credits/pers_def/dude/mission state, releases only captured-hull followers, derives outgoing afterburner/mining/voice, merges captured weapon banks under persistent_on_ship_swap (mode-99 same bank, remapped-bank overwrite), applies both flag arms with the source-bank secondary quirk and pre-rebuild fuel, writes the resolved captured-hull paint via Ship_ResolveShipTintColor, and emits STR# 0x7d2 0x130/0x131. The original's three global dirty flags are represented by GameState::InvalidateDerivedStatCaches (no separate inventory/presentation/availability flags).

name: System_UpdateDisasterStates
comment: Clean-room System_UpdateDisasterStates(GameState&) over the 0x100 öops slots (ScenarioData.disaster_defs): idle/undefined reset, per-day freq roll, ActivateOn gate via Mission_CheckReactionConditionSatisfied, 0x80-based target rebased to the 0-based index, and the -1 "any" arm picking a random available non-travel (flags 0x20) stellar. Wired into Mission_TickDailyWorldUpdate after the tribute pass. Divergence: the any arm builds the eligible set explicitly instead of rejection-sampling the full 0x800 g_stellar_defs table (the port table is shorter), and RNG uses state.rng. The started_once!=0 negative-duration repeat arm is dead in the shipped code (never set) but kept. Consumers still open: the commodity-exchange price delta (0x0048c730) and the travel-news disaster scan (0x0047d600) are unported, and the .plt block2 +0x3088/+0x3288 persistence is untracked.

name: Player_RefuelShipWithCredits
comment: Auto-refueller arrival refuel (Player_RefuelShipWithCredits, called from Stellar_Dock): owned-outfit ModType 19 scan (mod_type + alt_mod_types), fuel rounded to nearest unit then topped to effective capacity at 1 credit/unit clamped to credits. Marked 100%: no original behavior is unported. Divergence: the original's g_player_fuel_panel_dirty/inventory dirty flags are implied by the port's per-frame HUD; the travel_flags-0x20 else-arm (centered sound) is unreachable through the port's dock gate (logged).

name: EncounterFleet_TrySpawnRandomEncounterFleet
comment: Faithful reimpl as NovaEncounter_TrySpawnRandomFleet (src/game/ship_spawn.cpp/hpp): scans all 0x100 FleetDef slots

name: Ship_AllocateShipSlotInSystem
comment: NovaShip_AllocateShipSlot: faithful slot scan (reserved tail) + baseline reset of the load-bearing identity/kinematics/targeting/mission fields and [-750,750) position scatter; the skill_variance_percent / combat_state_init_range cadence draws implemented (from the reset class 0, as in the original). TODO(decomp): deep combat/AI residual field_0x* resets omitted until the ship AI/combat systems are reconstructed (see ship_spawn.cpp).

name: EncounterFleet_SpawnRandomEncounterFleet
comment: NovaEncounter_SpawnFleetLeadShip now faithfully shapes the lead, seeds cargo/loadout, rolls four escort ranges with ShipClass::is_available_runtime filtering, links/positions escorts, and reproduces the optional arrival STR# banner with # substitution. Remaining gap: the original centered arrival sound is not yet represented by a confirmed clean-room sound cue.

name: Frame_QueueCombatChatter
comment: Ported as NovaFrame_QueueCombatChatter: latches the (kind, government voice, variant) triple on GameState (original globals 0x7353fe/0x735400/0x735402). Called from the Shot_ResolveShotCollisionHit kill-witness loop in collision.cpp (escorts rooted at the player, AI state 4, attacking the destroyed ship, class not flags_secondary 0x10). The consumer pass Frame_UpdateCombatChatter remains TODO(decomp).

name: Mission_ShowMissionShipAnnouncement
comment: Ported: transition cue 4 via pending_ui_sounds; hail text prefers the `STR ` (hail+4999) single-string override and falls back to entry hail_quote_id of STR# 0x1bbd (7101), then runs Mission_ExpandStringPlaceholders and the 0x004444f0 wildcard pass (mission context cleared -> mission tokens [Error], <OSN> via GameState.mission_speaker_ship_slot) before a 0x1a4-tick overlay. Wired from NovaAi_SetShipHostileToPlayer's pers Flags 0x10 arm; HandleShip's per-frame throttle arm runs via Mission_TickShipHailLadder (see 0x00433050).

name: Mission_TrySpawnMissionShipAmbush
comment: Ported: pers slot 0x3fe present+loaded gate, dominated/hazard stellar count (is_available + dominated, availability 0x20 clear), 1-in-10 / 1-in-5 rolls, forced 0x3fe NovaPers_SpawnShipFromPersDef, NovaAi_SetShipHostileToPlayer (whose 0x10 arm may hail first -- double hail preserved), speaker latch + own hail. Dead g_hud_overlay_msg_color store skipped with TODO. Wired at the jump-arrival tail in spaceflight.cpp; TODO(decomp): the mission-fleet rearm/jump-in arms of the 0x00457580 slice it tails.

name: Weapon_CanWeaponHitTarget
comment: Engagement gates ported: mode-1 recorded-target matching, shared ai_target/stellar-target exclusions, faction/leader-chain exclusion, player-escort gates for player-aligned owner chains (owner-gov 0x40, target-gov 0x08, dude booty 0x100 both sides), owner scripted-maneuver 0x10, the 998 (0x3e6) target-lost inert latch, aggro-flag 0x40 final gate, and capability_flags 0x400 XOR. Unowned-shot branch (0x00427435) ported: owner_ship_slot outside 0..0x3f accepts only the recorded target slot, or a ship whose defense_fleet_home_stellar_id matches it, before joining the common tail; this is what lets stellar-defense-battery shots (owner -1) contact ships. Missing: fire-restricted range gate (ShipClassDef +0xa10 vs shot +0x42). TODO(decomp).

name: Weapon_SpawnWeaponImpactParticleBurst
comment: Ported as NovaEffects_SpawnWeaponImpactParticleBurst + NovaEffects_SpawnWeaponImpactBurstForWeapon: per-particle speed RNG (100+/-scatter), heading RNG (0..359 game deg), lifetime RNG [base, round(base*1.25)] and optional position scatter, preserving the original RNG order.

name: Outfit_GrantOutfitToPlayer
comment: NovaOutfit_GrantOutfitToPlayer: ModType 16 map reveal (ModVal >= 1 floods the link graph from the current system at discovery level 2; -1 reveals all neutral systems with a usable destination; <= -1000 reveals systems of governments carrying -(ModVal+1000) in Class 1-4); the first ModType-43 paint slot decodes its 15-bit ModVal into the global ship-paint 5-bit channels (state.ship_paint_rgb5, DAT_00733b4a/4c/4e), consumed by the hull tint.

name: Shot_QueueBeamHit
comment: First queue slice plus turret-exit selection: 64 bounded beam records, owner/target/weapon/lifetime state, direct NPC/player beam enqueue. The endpoint is only aimed at the recorded target for weapon_mode_code != 0; a mode-0 beam now stores its firing bearing and ends at BeamLength (Shot_UpdateBeamHitQueue gates the target endpoint on mode != 0). Turret-exit quadrant is selected from the ship's per-group rotation state Ship.muzzle_quadrant (ShipState +0xc8fe; -1 sentinel, randomize in [0,4)), flags_tertiary 0x10 target-nearest arm (0x0046c4e0) with the original's raw radians-as-degrees bearing (0x00427c98/0x00427cd9), and +1 mod 4 advance once per queued beam; BeamHit.turret_quadrant persists per record. Forced-targeting variants and full beam animation remain deferred; group outside [0,4) bounds-guarded with TODO(decomp(0x00427a90)) for the skipped out-of-range read/RNG. Endpoint rendering lives in spaceflight_view.cpp (0x00438c40 / 0x00438810). Locked-on non-player beams flagged non-lethal via NovaAiShip_IsShipLockedOnTarget (0x004124F0) + disabled-target guard.

name: Rank_Activate
comment: Ports the activation-side status flags (0x0001 clear same-govt, 0x0010 clear lower-weight), permanent 0x0008 skip, and g_recently_activated_rank_id maintenance (GameState.recently_activated_rank_id). K opcode wired in mission_script.cpp; RankDef model decoded in scenario_data.cpp.

name: Rank_Deactivate
comment: Ports the deactivation-side status flags (0x0002 clear same-govt, 0x0020 clear lower-weight), permanent 0x0008 skip, and recent-rank clear. L opcode and the crime revocation loop in Government_ProcessFactionCombatEvent are wired.

name: Shot_SpawnShipDestructionDebrisPuff
comment: Ported as NovaEffects_SpawnShipDestructionDebrisPuff: claims the first free fading-effect slot, lifetime rand(100)+150 (150..249), pos = ship pos, vel = ship vel + scatter (heading rand(360), magnitude (10+rand(10))*0.1 = DAT_00575208), heading = atan2(vel_x,-vel_y) (resulting-velocity bearing). Its Ship_HandleShip surrogate callsites queue the spatial DAT_00591a80 destruction cue after this visual helper returns, including when the 32-slot fragment pool is full; halfway puff gate and timed-action cascade are ported for NPCs. The class-0x2ff debris sprite is resolved by SpaceflightView::DrawFadingEffects through ShipClassSprite(0x2ff) = g_ship_sprite_base[0x2ff].

name: Ship_UpdateVisualState
comment: State-0x15 emergence presentation ported in SpaceflightView: hidden above the final 16 normalized hold ticks, then hull transparency falls 32->0 while pure-white distance tint falls 32->0 over the last 8 ticks; all sprite layers share the hidden hold, and ordinary effect-layer rules resume during the reveal. DESTRUCTION slice ported in ship_visual.cpp (NovaShip_TickDestroyedShipVisualState / NovaShip_RunShipDestructionFinale, wired in Stub_HandleShips for NPCs and Frame_TickSystems scope 10 for the player), including the class-0x2ff escape-pod exemption at Ghidra 0x00428b5c (NovaShip_TickDestroyedShipVisualStateRawCall returns before seeding, so the structurally 0-shield/0-armor pod never explodes); death-timer seed ownership latch (reset on player respawn/eject; BUGFIX(original): a DeathDelay of 0 or 1 reseeds to a low timer, so the original's fVar1 <= 0 branch retakes every call and neither the debris window nor the finale ever runs -- the gated branch runs the finale immediately for both delays when kApplyOriginalBugFixes is on and reproduces the reseed loop for both when off; the latch still guards the scheduler's below-zero overshoot for larger delays), the Explode1 debris-puff window (NovaShip_TickDestroyedDebrisPuffs: 1-in-1/2/4/8 rolls by the 20/40/60 bands, random hull offset, randomly silent area impact) and the Explode2 finale explosion (Shot_SpawnAreaImpactEffects at 0x0042cb00 with the blast radius + audio) now run for the player and NPCs alike, finale at 0<timer<=2.0 (DAT_0057531c) with hull blast (radius mass*0.075+50, damage mass*0.0375+25 -- the 0x00575380..98 constants are doubles, retyped from the misaligned `_f32` floats, capability 0x400 / pers 0x3ff exempt, force_armor_only + transition-check hit), mission destroy bookkeeping (goal_counter_a++, target_ship_count--, escort/goal-1/2/5 quick-fail with the +0xB9 boarded latch and runtime flags 0x0400), pers present-flag deactivation (1-in-8 for 0x3fe, Flags 0x0002 spare), is_active=0 + target clear. Weapon-effects flash + running-lights + engine-glow slices ported as NovaShip_TickWeaponSpriteAndRunningLights (wired for NPCs + player): the engine-glow brightness now follows 0x0042a383 exactly (level = engine_glow_level + NovaRandom_Range(6) - 4; hide when <2; clamp 32; alpha = level/32) replacing the level/24 approximation, with the per-ship distance-brightness fog reduction now applied (NovaShip_TickWeaponSpriteAndRunningLights caps level at trunc(32 - distance_brightness*1.5)); the WeaponDef flags_secondary 0x200 flash to 32 at the fire site decays by class weapon_glow_decay_rate (WeapDecay*binary64 0.333; Ghidra global 0x00575ab8 corrected from a misleading 4-byte float type) and the BlinkMode 0/-1/1/2/3 program drives Ship.light_intensity; the layers render in SpaceflightView. The class-level g_pref_running_lights/g_pref_weapon_effects load gates are not honored (preferences not on GameState). Cargo-escort destruction removes proportional player cargo/junk before deactivation (0x00469810, active destroyed recipient included in denominator), reconciles weapon/outfit pools, and invalidates derived stats. Sprite-frame composition decoded (row * FramesPer + heading_frame; bank rows 1/2 from ai_turn_bias_dir, alt-sheet layout) and reimplemented (ComposeShipFrameIndex + shyan AltImageID/AltSetCount decode). Cloak-fade slice ported as NovaShip_TickCloakFadeState (latch 0 passive decay time-adjusted to the original raw 21 ms call cadence (1.0 at elapsed_ticks 0.63), armed latch integrates latch*rate*tick_scale toward the 32.0/0.0 clamps, rate 1.5 vs 0.75 on class Flags2 0x1, destroyed latch -2 arm); wired in Stub_HandleShips for NPCs and PlayerTick_InteractionCloakAndStatus for the player. The wreck keeps full hull opacity until this finale calls Sprite_SetVisible(0) (NovaShip_RunShipDestructionFinale sets is_active=0). SPRITE ROW FLAGS + ALT (2026): NovaShip_TickSpriteAnimation advances the base row-select state machines (Flags 0x0001 banking via ai_turn_bias_dir; 0x0002 fold/unfold via waypoint_arrival_marker_b/turn_bank_animation_phase with the 0x0080 fire re-trigger; 0x0004 carry resolved at draw time; 0x0008 sequence via sprite_animation_cycle_index/sprite_animation_timer), each AnimDelay-stepped and guarded on BaseSetCount>=2, plus the AltImageID overlay cycle (alternate_sprite_cycle_index +0xC8F4). ComposeShipBaseRow derives the displayed row. Fire sites store last_weapon_fire_time_ms (+0xA8) and fold Flags-0x02|0x80 hulls. The renderer draws the alt sheet over the hull and loads (draw deferred) the ShieldImageID bubble; disabled/escort/normal sub-layers and the mode4_alt shot layer are reproduced (SpaceflightView::DrawShipsInLayer / DrawShots). Base-hull tint consumes Ship_ResolveShipTintColor (0x0046E470) via state.ship_paint_rgb5 and SpriteDrawOptions.tint_rgb5, rendered as an SDL color mod; the original's additive overflow above the 0x20 neutral and base_transparency blend are not reproduced (documented divergence). Disabled-light suppression (sprite_behavior_flags 0x0040, Bible "Hide running light sprites when the ship is disabled") now zeroes Ship.light_intensity after the blink state machine so disabled hulls go dark.

name: Frame_UpdateFreeflightObjectSprites
comment: NovaFreeflight_Tick (position integration, lifetime expiry, spin/frame advance wrapped in [0,36)) + SpaceflightView::DrawFreeflightObjects (500+index spin draw, frame from the accumulator, alpha fade over the final 32 ticks, current-system filter). Distance fog applied via SpaceflightView::DrawFreeflightObjects (Sprite_DistanceBrightness + ApplyFog; see docs/system_murk_rendering.md). Unused by all 256 stock Nova weapons.

name: Stellar_UpdateStellarSprites
comment: Ambient frame stepping is ported with normalized 30 Hz timing, AnimDelay/Frame0Bias dwell, Flags2 0x1 return and 0x2 random modes, Flags2 0x80 active/destroyed-zone gating, and full hypergate opening/working/closing driven by player engagement plus NPC states 0x01/0x14/0x15 and the original 2x-width/1.1x approach envelope. name: Stellar_TickStellarDefenseBatteries
comment: Ported as NovaStellar_TickStellarDefenseBatteries, wired into Stub_MiscHandlers (scope 8) before the crash pass; helpers NovaWeapon_AimStellarBatteryShot + NovaWeapon_SpawnStellarBatteryShot (weapon.cpp) and NovaGovernment_IsCandidateHostileToTargeter (government.cpp). Reproduces the 16 nav slots, is_available + weapon_id != -1 + !Stellar_IsStellarActive, the +0x494 cooldown ticked by g_avg_frame_tick_scale, nearest-hostile-within-range^2, the disabled-target gate, shared 128-shot-pool retry, AI-state-8 / hazard / special(0x200)+0x47 target gates, shot field init, spread wrap, lock-quality seeding, and the burst counter/reset cooldown. Scheduling divergence: the original calls scope 8 on reduced ticks and this function has its own gameplay-frozen guard; the current port dispatches it only on full ticks because it has no explicit freeze latch. This is behaviorally equivalent for the current loop, whose only reduced path is frozen, but must be revised before any non-frozen reduced tick is added. Indexing verified: the loader (0x004bd3c0) rebases the raw spob Weapon (+0x23a) by -0x80 into StellarDef +0x2c (values <0x80 -> -1), so the tick's g_weapon_defs[+0x2c] is a bank slot consistent with the bank-indexed table (Spacedock II 196 -> bank 68 = Enormous Blaster Turret); the port keeps the raw resource id and resolves through ScenarioData::Weapon to the same bank. ActiveShot lacks ShotState +0x24/+0x32/+0x40 (unused by the port sim) and pending_fire_sounds does not carry the original variant 5. Cooldown reloads only when a shot actually spawns. Shots connect through Weapon_CanWeaponHitTarget's ownerless branch (owner_ship_slot -1 accepts the recorded target slot; see 0x00426EF0). Confidence high.

name: Shot_UpdateBeamHitQueue
comment: Queue tick advances lifetime/endpoints and resolves queued beam impacts through the shared shield/armor/status and impact-effect path. Source is refreshed from the live owner each tick including the per-frame turret-exit offset (Weapon_ApplyTurretSpreadVelocity 0x0046c5c0, stored BeamHit.turret_quadrant/group, bounds-guarded; rotation from the displayed frame, near/far scale, drop), so a moving/rotating owner is tracked. Mode-0 beams keep the owner's current heading (queued bearing fallback) and scan: reach = BeamLength + ceil(trunc(frame_span*0.66)/2), cone half-angle = trunc(frame_span*0.66)*10/32 deg, truncation = trunc(distance - frame_span*0.2) (all x87 FIST truncation idiom, not nearest-even), with frame_span = Sprite_GetShipClassEscortFrameWidth 0x004624c0 (which calls Sprite_GetFrameFullWidth, so the full frame WIDTH; port uses collision-mask width, 0x4b=75 fallback); nothing in reach ends at BeamLength, and a near-reach hit is not re-clamped to BeamLength. 0.66/0.2 are DAT_005753d0/DAT_005753d8. Eligibility uses the original inline beam scan (BeamCandidateEligible): active/same-system/not-owner/ship_class!=0x2ff, weapon flags 0x400 vs class capability_flags 0x400, squad/player-squad exclusions and dude booty-0x100 exclusions; it deliberately allows same-government non-squad hits (unlike Weapon_CanWeaponHitTarget 0x00426ef0). Turreted modes track the target. The impact call forwards the original's suppress_retarget_logic argument: a mode-0 swept contact passes true only when it equals the beam's recorded target or the owner's live primary target, so a stray player beam is gated by Ship_ApplyDamageToShip's player-aggro accumulator instead of instantly aggroing the victim. The negative-impact-impulse arm is ported through NovaWeapon_ResolveDirectWeaponHit: a tractor/repulsor beam (impact_impulse < 0, target pers_def_slot != 0x3ff, target mass >= 1 and capability 0x400 clear) arms the target or source +0xC8DC velocity-match lock with the +0xB4 stamp; target.mass*0.75 (DAT_005753e8) <= source.mass locks the target, else the source self-locks and, at >= 50 px (DAT_005753f0) separation, is pulled toward the target before the damage impulse is suppressed. Remaining gaps: asteroid arm, scripted-manoeuvre arm, single hit resolution, no shot_random_spread bearing jitter. Beam rendering in spaceflight_view.cpp.

name: Ship_HandleShip
comment: NovaShip_IntegrateNpcMovement (spaceflight_movement.cpp) plus Stub_HandleShips/TickShipHandleDestructionDebrisPuffs (spaceflight.cpp), Mission_TickShipHailLadder (mission.cpp) and NovaWeapon_TickNpcWeaponBanks (weapon_banks.cpp). Branches ported: validation/reset prologue; per-bank cooldown decay, ionization pin and mode-99 reload; disabled 0.995 damping + player-led escort conversion / Frame_ShouldTriggerAutoRepairTick auto-repair / post_hit_mode_hint STR# 0x7d2 surrender; personality shield_armor_scale pin; hail ladder; velocity-match tug (player thrust x0.25 quirk) + 30-tick +0xB4 expiry; cloak upkeep and fuel/shield drain; zero-accel zero-velocity; position integration; ionization decay/ramp; turn + effective-max shield/armor regen; heading wrap; state-2/mode-4 jump spin-up; thrust; turn-bank phase ramp and +-4 bias; weapon handoff; maneuver timer; death timer + player-led cargo transfer + debris puffs; fuel recharge / capacity clamp; aggro decay; derelict glow; destroyed 1-in-3 launch-bay ejection with weapon-counter zeroing (all replayed on the 21 ms call cadence). The movement clamp/threshold uses NovaShip_ComputeEffectiveMaxSpeedPxPerTick, applying the +1.5x player-led-squad tail (DAT_005757b8). Branch accounting complete: the two divergences are accepted platform substitutions, not missing behavior -- g_playerShipPresentationDirty (immediate-mode HUD redraw) and the 21 ms raw-call constant replay via the shared elapsed/0.63 cadence. The ionization decay/ramp now runs at its original position inside NovaShip_IntegrateNpcMovement (after position integration, before turn/regen), so the turn and thrust blocks read the freshly decayed intensity. The velocity-match +0xC8DC/+0xB4 producer is wired (Shot_UpdateBeamHitQueue's negative-impulse arm via NovaWeapon_ResolveDirectWeaponHit), the class-0x2ff thrust/turn-bank/HUD-maneuver-timer gate exception is handled (holds_course + skip), and the surrender overlay's shared g_hud_overlay_text_color is faithful.

name: Shot_HandleShot
comment: NovaWeapon_TickShots follows Shot_HandleShot ordering. Outer expiry (system_id != current || life_time <= 0) runs the impact block only when still in-system and life > k_shot_expiry_min_life_f32 (-32000.0), then retires with life_time=-2; plain (flags_primary 0x8000 clear) weapons spawn the single default impact sprite only when impact_effect_id > 0 and the original's always-zero effect id quirk is preserved, while 0x8000 weapons take the area helper plus the splash-damage pass over active ships within splash_radius on both axes (owner immunity, capability 0x400 skip, flags_secondary 0x400 suppression, Weapon_ApplyWeaponOnHitEffects, truncated Reload aggro delta). The live branch latches -1 on the crossing frame and still guides/moves/animates, so linked submunitions and the impact now fire one tick later, matching the original. flags_tertiary 0x4 resets the owner's bank cooldown to Reload each live frame. The continuous SWParticle trail arm is ported (Bible Particles/PartVel/PartLifeMin/PartLifeMax/PartColor +0x24..0x2c, 0.60..1.40 variants, range-overwrites-speed-slot-zero quirk); smoke-trails preference suppression wired. The per-shot shot_fade_rate quads are modelled exactly: TickShots latches the PRE-advance words -- ordinary a2 = 32-progress (negative rate) or min(progress,0x1f) (positive), additive (flags_tertiary 0x2) a2 = 0x20 with the a4 RGB corner = progress for negative (which never advances visibility, the original quirk) or max(4,32-progress) for positive, and the no-fade additive path full 0x20. The renderer uses the latched alpha natively (ordinary (32-a2)/32, additive corner/32, additive blend); the particle trail now passes 32-a2 as its blend weight. The animated display frame is latched before the animation increment and the ProxSafety flags2 0x1|0x2 reset overrides it to frame 0. Flags1 0x0001 animated sprites accumulate normalized 30 Hz ticks against Bible BeamWidth and reset to zero; Bible Decay accumulates with strict interval comparison and increments damage_decay_points. Target-chain arm now ported with the one-time pre/post-decrement guidance-age crossing gate; expiry constant corrected to k_shot_expiry_min_life_f32 = -32000.0 (0x005754b8) and the sprite +0x14 visible/prepared gate documented (consumed substitutes). Renderer parity: Frame_UpdateSpriteDistanceIntensity's per-sprite +0xaa word is reproduced by Sprite_DistanceBrightness (32-bit float product with the original 32-bit integer wrap); the shot draw passes the original anchor floor(full_width/2) on BOTH axes (0x00435f29, the width reused on y -- an original quirk) and smoke uses floor(width/2)/floor(height/2); the smoke +0xa2..+0xa8 = 0x20 tint is equivalent to full alpha + fog. Only the original's short-position snap is not reproduced (sub-pixel renderer divergence). The player target-chain arm is ported (one-time pre/post-decrement crossing gate); its recomputed-guard decompile ambiguity is documented.

name: Asteroid_UpdateSprites
comment: NovaAsteroid_UpdateSprites ports the state half (deactivate on inactive/integrity<=-32000/no_asteroids_latch; integrate target_pos by target_vel and wander_frame_accumulator by wander_speed in 30Hz ticks). Viewport handling is SpaceflightView::WrapAsteroids; sprite bind + frame draw is DrawAsteroids (spin id 800+wander_type, frame trunc(wander_frame_accumulator) wrapped by the set frame count); both cite this address in src/game/spaceflight_view.cpp. DIVERGENCE (documented, deliberate): the original culls an off-window record (own frame extent; negative side 1.5x span, positive 0.5x) and deactivates it, with Frame_TickSystems refilling via Asteroid_Spawn(place_in_ring=1) on a ring of radius ~1.5*center_y; WrapAsteroids instead teleports the record in world space using the largest loaded frame span for both threshold and distance and never deactivates. This masks the original's 'small asteroids vanish at high resolution' defect (ring refills landing outside the cull window) rather than reproducing it; identified plausibly, fixed by divergence. Distance fog applied in SpaceflightView::DrawAsteroids (Sprite_DistanceBrightness + ApplyFog; see docs/system_murk_rendering.md). TODO(decomp): g_ai_target_refresh_needed slot-0 promotion branch not modelled; per-record Sprite +0x54 frame count taken from the loaded spin set (all shipped asteroid sets 50x50/36) rather than a runtime Sprite.

name: Asteroid_HandleSpritePairCollision
comment: INTERNAL LABEL of the asteroid sprite layer; standalone callback, not a Ghidra function. Installed on the 16 asteroid sprites by FUN_004af020 (+0x94). Reads the shot/asteroid indices from presented_object_id (+0xC8), rejects flags_quaternary 0x0001 (Seeker 1), tests the decoded per-frame pixel masks (Sprite_TestPixelMaskOverlap 0x00475C80 -> clean-room SpriteMask_TestOverlap in src/game/sprite_mask.cpp), then calls NovaUi_ResolveWeaponSplashImpact. Ported as ResolveDirectAsteroidContact; unlike ship/proximity contacts, this callback has no Bible ProxSafety gate. Circle envelope remains only the fallback when no sprite mask resolves. Asteroid frame selection mirrors Asteroid_UpdateSprites (wander_frame_accumulator wrapped by the spin set frame count).

name: NovaUi_ResolveWeaponSplashImpact

Weapon SWParticle impact burst ported (scatter 0x14).

name: Ship_HandleSpritePairCollision
comment: Restructured as the direct-contact pass: CanWeaponHitTarget -> (pixel-mask or circle) overlap -> Bible ProxSafety initial-delay rejection -> Shot_ResolveShotCollisionHit with linked shots disallowed, driven by an explicit shot x ship loop instead of SpriteLayer overlaps. Pixel-mask overlap ported (Sprite_TestPixelMaskOverlap 0x00475C80 -> SpriteMask_TestOverlap, src/game/sprite_mask.cpp). The original's mask-vs-circle decision is reproduced: ShipContactUsesPixelMask takes the mask iff GameState::last_frame_tick_scale < 2.0 (k_pixel_collision_frame_scale_threshold_f64 0x005754C8, the port's g_avg_frame_tick_scale 0x00735448) AND the target ship frame width > 0x20 (Sprite_GetFrameFullWidth 0x00462390); Ship_UpdateVisualState frame selection (heading + banking row) is mirrored. Freeflight-object scoop arm ported as NovaWeapon_ResolveFreeflightScoop (persistent objects only, pixel mask, extra 0..5 cargo / 1000..1127 player junk, OutfitMarkStatsDirty capacity gate); NPC AI-state-0x11 cargo bins remain TODO(decomp). Asteroid_HandleSpritePairCollision 0x00436F70 runs for each shot that did not hit a ship and always uses its resolved mask.

name: Shot_ResolveShotCollisionHit
comment: Direct + proximity impacts: area impact effect, unattenuated direct ionization (impact_pos NULL), Bible Decay damage_decay_points subtracted from both direct damage terms with zero clamps, splash loop with owner-immunity polarity (NPC owners always immune; player immune only with flags_primary 0x100), full undecayed splash damage plus attenuated on-hit effects, reload-scaled player aggro delta. The trailing allow_linked_shots flag now gates NovaWeapon_SpawnLinkedShotsOnImpact (0x00420D30): the blast-proximity pass (0x00437e20) passes true, the direct sprite-contact pass (0x004374f0) false. Takes a shot index now so the spawner may reallocate GameState::active_shots. Weapon SWParticle impact burst ported (scatter 0x14) at the primary impact.

name: Shot_ResolveCollisions
comment: Blast-proximity pass, separate from the direct-contact pass: per live shot with Bible ProxSafety initial-delay gating (remaining life must be below Count - ProxSafety). (1) Planet-type weapons (flags_secondary 0x0400) run ResolveShotStellarContact against the current system's 16 nav stellars (Sprite_TestPixelMaskOverlap 0x00475C80 -> SpriteMask_TestOverlap): eligible when strength_capacity>0 and !NovaTargeting_IsStellarActive; a hit subtracts combined energy+mass damage from Stellar.strength, spawns the weapon area impact, kills the shot, and on strength<0 runs the destruction package. (2) blast_radius weapons scan ships with CanWeaponHitTarget and integer-rounded dist^2 <= ROUND(blast + span/3)^2, first hit wins and calls Shot_ResolveShotCollisionHit with linked shots allowed. (3) Asteroid branch uses NovaUi_ResolveWeaponSplashImpact, gated on flags_quaternary bit 0. Weapon impact particles and destroyed-stellar faction events are ported.

name: Shot_DrawBeamQueue
comment: Restore-phase beam replot entry: called only from Frame_RestoreViewportRectsAndParticles (0x00439d20). Loops the 0x40-slot g_beam_hit_queue and replays each live beam into the saved-backdrop surface via SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam (field_0x76 < 1, 1-segment) or SWBeams_DrawBeamWithFlare (field_0x76 >= 1, 2-segment arc). The port keeps no saved-backdrop buffer, so this entry point is not reproduced, but the two plotters it calls are also reachable from the visible 0x00438810 twin-surface path and are tracked separately. 0%, not ported.

Not reproduced yet: the field_0xec != 0 twin-surface branches (field_0xec = both-surfaces redraw, meaning provisional) replay every live beam to both gameplay surfaces via SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam/SWBeams_DrawBeamWithFlare, including the under-ships flags-0x2000 twin branch. The port always draws the single-surface SWBeams_DrawShortBeam/SWBeams_DrawThickFadingBeam appearance.

name: Shot_DrawUnderShipsBeamQueue

name: Frame_UpdateSpriteDistanceIntensity
comment: Sprite_DistanceBrightness: distance_brightness = clamp(trunc(effective_murk * distSq * 1.2e-05), 0, 0x1f) with distSq the squared x87-truncated player/sprite axis deltas. Applied through SpriteDrawOptions.fog_murk/fog_color + DrawSprite/BlitFrame as a two-pass masked fog: the frame silhouette is painted in the space colour (occluding dst), then the source at (1-d/32) over it; d>=0x1f snaps to fully fogged (the original 5-bit >>5 truncation zeroes the source there). Additive layers fold (1-d/32) into the intensity. Consumed by ships/stellars/shots/freeflight/asteroids/impact/fading draws and the NPC engine-glow cap. The original also clamps to 0x18 at 8-bit depth; the port is always 32-bit.

name: Mission_TickDailyCronEvents
comment: Ported (mission_world.cpp): full daily state machine over the 0x200 crön slots. Reproduced verbatim when kApplyOriginalBugFixes is off; under the policy the confirmed original bugs are corrected: Random is a true 1..100 percent roll (original draws 0..100 and tests <=, so Random 0 fires ~1/101 and the effective odds are (odds+1)/101); the date window is a contiguous multi-year interval (original 0x0046c800 checks the year bounds and the month*0x20+day composite independently, so 1/1/1178-1/1/1179 collapses to New Year's Day only - shipped Terraforming Start 0x0081); a duration-0 event runs OnEnd once (original leaves the slot active with holdoff 0, re-running OnEnd on the next tick - 49 shipped events); the post-end wait is PostHoldoff (original 0x004395d9 reads block +0x22 = PreHoldoff, and with PreHoldoff == 0 the slot never deactivates and re-runs OnEnd daily - shipped 0x00b8/0x00b9/0x00c0). Require mask + EnableOn gates, pre/post holdoff counters, duration countdown -> OnEnd. Date window's FirstMonth-only start gate now matches 0x0046c835. crön decode in ScenarioData (125 present; loader offsets verified); inactive-slot save sentinel matches 0x004c7dd0. News-govt STR# display implemented in NovaUi_ComposeTravelNewsTexts (0x0047D600).

Vector pools are capped to the original 128-shot scan.

name: Stellar_HandleShipStellarCrash
comment: Ported as NovaStellar_HandleShipStellarCrash: per current-system nav stellar, requires availability_flags 0x100 (Bible deadly) and a resolved ambient sprite mask (Ghidra StellarDef+0 is the live Sprite*); each active, non-destroyed ship not immune under Stellar_ShipImmuneToStellarCrash is tested with Sprite_TestPixelMaskOverlap 0x00475C80 (clean-room SpriteMask_TestOverlap). Contact is an instant animation-free kill: is_active=0, armor=-1000.0f (0xc47a0000), death_timer=0, player primary target cleared when it was the victim, and the class final explosion effect (ShipClassDef+0xa1e = destruction_effect_final, payload +0x3a) spawned at the ship. The ship scan does not early-out. Wired into Stub_MiscHandlers (Frame_TickSystems scope 8) after the gravity pull. Not reproduced: g_playerShipPresentationDirty (implicit in the immediate-mode redraw).

name: Ship_SteerVelocityTowardShipHeading

Both per-axis branch directions and the 4.0 constant are disasm-verified. Divergence: the port's radian heading uses sin/cos rather than the original integer-degree Math_LookupAngle* tables (project-wide heading representation).

name: Frame_UpdateFadingEffectSprites
comment: NovaEffects_TickFadingEffects advances the 32-slot debris pool with inherited/randomized velocity and lifetime expiry; SDL draw uses special class 0x2ff, while exact sprite anchoring bookkeeping remains partial; distance fog now applied via Sprite_DistanceBrightness + ApplyFog (see docs/system_murk_rendering.md). The DAT_00596d29 clear (shared with the beam queue) is now wired through NovaWeapon_ClearTransientCombatState at the same transition boundaries.

name: Math_AddPolarVelocity
comment: polar velocity convention (heading 0=up, clockwise, vel_x=sin, vel_y=-cos) reproduced inline in NovaPlayer_IntegrateMovement; not a distinct function yet

name: Math_AddPolarVelocityWithClamp
comment: per-axis polar clamp reproduced faithfully (caps thrust per-axis at polar max projection; no magnitude governor) via Math_AddPolarVelocityWithClamp; angle lookup tables approximated with sin/cos

name: Math_ClampVelocityComponents

Opcodes A/F/S/G/D/M/N/C/E/H/K/L/P/Q/T/U/X/Y: A runs the OnAbort payload and releases the fleet via Mission_ClearMisnSlotAssignments(slot, true); S saves/forces/restores g_travel_scene_ctx around Mission_ResolveMissionStellarTargets + Mission_ActivateAtSlot; C/E/H reconcile, drop Flags-0x24-clear outfits for H, rebuild banks, add class stock weapons additively (NovaWeapon_AddShipClassStockBanks) plus DefaultItems, reconcile/clamp/rebuild, repair a disabled hull +1.0 armor until un-disabled, and raise GameState.gameplay_interface_dirty for HudRenderer::Install; M/N run the non-transition tail (transient clear, primary target clear, NovaTargeting_UpdateStellarAvailability, Mission_RefreshActiveMissionSpawnState) and N's tail runs even for an out-of-range id; U restores strength = strength_capacity, destroyed_days_remaining = -1; Y spawns the in-system explosion only when watching, sets destroyed_days_remaining from schedule_days (negative -> 1) and strength = -1. Q stages the composed text in GameState.pending_overlay_message; the BBS poll's staged-message force-leave (0x00440c90 action 7) remains tracked on that row. X writes only discovery_state = 1. Divergences: the docked M/N transition arm clears the g_mission_slot_list/g_return_mission_list tables, which the port rebuilds lazily so there is nothing to clear; control-bit operands < 0 are clamp-dropped instead of writing out of bounds; the opcode case fold is modelled as an ASCII toupper (MWRuntime_ToUpper 0x004d6260); the MissionTrace diagnostic logging has no original equivalent. BUGFIX(original), currently ungated (always-on): for a mode-99 carried-ship bay the original C/E/H adds default_weapon_secondary to weapon_secondary_count_by_class[ammo_type], where AmmoType is the carried ship class id (Bible Guidance 99), but the original's own read/spend paths (Weapon_GetWeaponBurstAttempts 0x0046f2c0, Weapon_CanFireWeaponBank, Weapon_FirePlayerWeaponBank) and the capture/new-game seeding (0x00423fa0) use the bay's own counter for mode 99, so an original script class-swap would leave the bay at zero; NovaWeapon_AddShipClassStockBanks keeps the count in the bay counter to match them (74 shipped stock bay loadouts, mostly Fed/Pirate/Aurora carriers plus Scarab/Raven/Kestrel). name: PilotFile_SaveGameCore
comment: PilotFileSerialize covers the block1/block2 offsets and framing, including active escorts/fighters, përs active/visible flags, paint RGB5, date affixes, missions, world state, nickname, and ship-name trailer. Active missions retain the complete opaque 0x8e6 payload while modeled counters, runtime DateTimeRec words, and all six script buffers are overlaid; block2 +0x2006 and +0x5efe are zero-filled because the original explicitly clears them. Remaining deliberate divergence: license-seed class-id behavior. block1+0x00 is the 0-based g_stellar_defs index (PilotFileStellarIndexFromResourceId rebases resource ids); a raw resource id mis-placed the restored player. ShipState +0x72 (active secondary bank) is intentionally not written; only the weapon-bank counters are saved. Confidence high on offsets.

name: Menu_OpenPilotFileDialog
comment: SDL3 native .plt chooser is wired asynchronously into the main menu; selected files run the original pre-load NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState and accept PilotFileLoadSave repair status -0x2e. After a successful load the dispatcher tail runs the vacancy sweep, mission-fleet restore (flag==1 -> copy_player_heading=true), ambient NPC population and the per-system region loop (is_visible && discovery_state > 0; 0x004870c4-0x004870e7); EvaluateAvailability/Asteroid_Init stay in the spaceflight-entry pre-loop and the mission rearm tail in PilotFileLoadSave to avoid duplication, and player escorts are restored by the loader. Remaining: reputation reset, error dialogs, and the STR# 0x8c entry 0x34 repair-warning dialog.

name: PilotData_AutoresumeLastPilot
comment: Reads Last Pilot exclusively from SDL's writable per-user preference path after staged startup loading; resolves the saved path, runs the original pre-load NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState, and auto-activates only an exact-success load. Repaired (-0x2e) pilots are left inactive for explicit Open Pilot handling, matching the original caller. Remaining: reputation reset and post-load region-event/mission reaction schedule reseeding.

name: PilotDebug_WritePilotLog
comment: debug-only pilotlog.txt dump (licensed runtime only); not reconstructed

name: PilotFile_LoadSave
comment: File I/O, retail XOR decode, name/path restore, definition repairs, inventory/world/mission/fleet state, përs active/visible gates, paint RGB5, date affixes, mission deadline/display-name/count/rearm transient rebuild, last-pilot marker, final availability/discovery refresh, and player/escort transient reset are ported. Both port callers now run NovaShip_ResetPlayerShipState first, matching the original load ownership. The active secondary bank (ShipState +0x72) is deliberately not restored: this loader never touches it, so PilotFileApply now preserves the pre-load Ship_ResetPlayerShipState -1 instead of applying an unsaved default-0 field that re-selected bank 0 (the Shuttle's Light Blaster) as a secondary on reload. Deliberate compatibility divergence: converted big-endian Mac payload and Pascal nickname auto-detection. block1+0x00 is read as a 0-based g_stellar_defs index (matching 0x004cb260's direct indexing). Remaining: optional PilotDebug_WritePilotLog only.

name: PilotFile_ProbeExists
comment: PilotFile_ProbeExists: reimplemented as filesystem is_regular_file probe (original opens the file)

name: PilotFile_Delete
comment: PilotFile_Delete: probe-guarded remove

name: Resource_LoadRandomStringEntry

name: NameString_StripSubtitleSuffix
comment: Implemented as NovaText_StripSubtitleSuffix: truncates at the last ';', trims the run of spaces immediately before it, and returns a name with no ';' unchanged (trailing spaces preserved). Shared by new_pilot_flow and scenario_data.

name: PilotData_FindActivePilotName
comment: Scans the ch\x9ar archive family (0x63688a72) in id order for flags bit 0 at block+0x132 (big-endian u16)

name: PilotData_ResolveStartType
comment: ResolveStartTypeFromTemplate: ch r block+4 minus 0x80 with <0x80 -> 0 fallback; block grow/release and by-key access semantics not reproduced

name: IntroCinematic_SetupFrames
comment: Faithful NovaIntroCinematic_SetupFrames: keyed block lookup by character-template name (ResourceData_AccessByKey via NovaResource_AccessCharacterBlockByKey); fills source_pict_ids block+0x20, duration_60h_ticks block+0x28 (clamped [0,300]), and intro_text_desc_id block+0x30 (Bible char IntroTextID; renamed from the misnomer post_intro_dest_id). Absent block -> PICT 0x2008/10 ticks/desc 0x7ffd. See docs/char_resource_format.md.

name: PilotData_InitializePlayerState
comment: Absent-block seed in PilotFile::Fresh (10000 credits, class 0, system 0, date 2250/1/1). The param_2 != 0 branch is read by CharacterTemplate_Read (0x63688a72 keyed block, big-endian, short blocks zero-padded): Cash (+0x00), ShipType (+0x04), System1-4 (+0x06), Govt1-4/Status1-4 (+0x0e/+0x16), Kills (+0x1e), start date (+0x134/+0x136/+0x138), DatePrefix/DateSuffix (+0x13a/+0x14a) and OnStart (+0x32). new_pilot_flow applies these and now the random System1-4 start-system pick via PilotData_PickStartingSystem, which reuses the original selection/rejection draw cadence (port mt19937; system 0 and no draw when no slot is valid). Remaining: block grow/dirty/release semantics and the in-memory registry merge. See docs/char_resource_format.md.

name: ResourceData_VerifyCatalogChecksum
comment: Full-catalog resource integrity check: sums FUN_004fe285 over 0x17 resource types and compares to the stored checksum in resource type 0x63739f6d, showing STR# 0x8c entry 7 on mismatch. Called between the startup splash and the progress-bar reveal. Deliberately not ported (licence/tamper checks out of scope); the loading bar therefore appears immediately on the startup splash instead of after this pass.

comment: Ported control drawer: bevel triples Static text (type 8) now wraps via WrapDescriptionLines with real Ascent/LineHeight metrics, top-aligned and clipped to the item rect; edit text/selection/caret clip to the field rect inset by 3 (0x004bcd30/ NovaText_DrawText semantics). The item pass saves and restores the renderer clip through util::RenderClipScope.

name: NovaList_Create
comment: List-control constructor (rect, row pitch, row count, scrollbar-enabled flag) modelled as the NovaListControl constructor (nova_list_control.cpp), the clean-room counterpart of the native list control. The original's text buffer, per-row offset table and draw-callback fields (+0x28/+0x2c/+0x1c) are not reproduced: the dialogs own std::vector row text and paint it through NovaUi_DrawListRow. Provisional; only the fields the mission lists consume are modelled.

name: NovaList_ScrollSelectionIntoView
comment: Scroll-selected-row-into-view modelled as NovaListControl::EnsureVisible: no-op when the whole list fits, otherwise scroll by (selected - current offset) so the row is just inside. Converges on the same offset as the original's minimum-delta scroll.

name: NovaList_HitTestPoint
comment: Point-to-row mapping modelled as NovaListControl::RowAt and the scrollbar arm as NovaListScrollbarHitTest: content clicks map to (y - list.top)/pitch + scroll, the 15px strip classifies arrow caps / above- and below-thumb page bands / thumb; on-thumb clicks are a no-op (the original has no drag). TODO(decomp): the +0x38 last-click 60 Hz tick stamp is not modelled.

name: NovaList_GetRowRect
comment: Row rectangle modelled as NovaListControl::RowRect: list.top + (row - scroll) * pitch, list-local x/width; matches the original's FUN_004b8d80 + Rect_Offset composition.

name: NovaList_ScrollByRows
comment: Scroll-by-rows modelled as NovaListControl::ScrollRows: offset += delta, clamped to [0, row_count - visible_rows] with visible_rows = floor(height/pitch), exactly the original's integer clamp.

name: NovaList_Draw
comment: List redraw modelled as NovaUi_DrawListScrollbar plus the dialogs' clipped row loop: row rectangles and per-row fills/labels via NovaUi_DrawListRow, then a 15px scrollbar with frame, trough, up/down chevrons and a proportional thumb (no drag; on-thumb clicks are inert). TODO(decomp): the native grip/hash lines and exact thumb rounding.

name: NovaAudio_FillVoiceSlotDescriptor

name: Audio_AllocateVoiceSlot

DirectSound handles and callback fields are deliberately replaced by RAII SDL streams.

name: NovaAudio_CountActiveByHandle
comment: SdlAudio::CountActiveByKey counts draining voices with matching resource key. Original also accepts owner-link ids and handle 0 as count-all; neither form is needed by reconstructed callsites.

name: NovaAudio_UnregisterCallbacks

name: FUN_004fcac0

name: ResourceData_FindNodeForHandle

name: MemOrStream_ResolveId
comment: Registry id resolver, provisional: opens the entry for a small-int resource id against a registry root; callers chain it for path resolution (MemOrStream_OpenOrResolvePath 0x004da370).

name: NovaMusic_SwitchBackgroundTrack
comment: Background 'bass' music playback via the vendored dr_mp3 decoder and a dedicated looping SDL audio stream, avoiding an SDL3_mixer/mpg123 LGPL-2.1 runtime dependency.

name: Debug_HandleCheatAndNcbCommands
comment: Cheat-mode arming plus debug NCB condition-test/set-script dialogs; called from Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore and returns the caller's command probe. Renamed in Ghidra from the misleading Mission_TickReactionInputTrigger; unported debug path.

name: DrawContext_SetHyperspaceFlashColor
comment: DrawContext colour setter for the hyperspace flash (3 call sites: Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore arrival 0x0044f729, Stellar_EnterHypergate 0x00456767, Stellar_EnterWormhole 0x00456f27): applies the requested RGB triplet unless the raw g_hyperspace_effects byte is non-zero, in which case it forces black. Renamed from the provisional Input_ApplyRawInputPacket (the raw-input reading was wrong). The port has no DrawContext; the gate is expressed as NovaPrefs_HyperspaceFlashIsBlack (preferences.hpp) resolved by the spaceflight loop into GameState.screen_flash_black, which spaceflight_view.cpp draws as a black vs white full-screen overlay. Preference round-trips via .prf +0x78 already verified.

name: NovaUi_StarmapEnableBordersAction
comment: The Show/Hide Borders action: enables the political overlay and continues the starmap inner loop. Ported inline in NovaStarmap_RunWindow's button switch (case StarmapButton::kShowBorders): toggles GameState::starmap_show_borders (runtime copy of NovaPreferences::starmap_show_borders, .prf +0x76) and rebuilds the overlay.

name: PilotSave_DecodeBlock
comment: DecodePilotBlock leaves plaintext blocks with u16[0] < 0x800 unchanged and otherwise applies the symmetric 0xb36a210f XOR stream from the 0x0046f960 tail call; archived Windows and converted big-endian Mac pilots load through it

name: ResourceArchive_OpenAllRezInNovaFiles
comment: EnsureLoaded opens every case-insensitively sorted *.rez under <install>/Nova Files via EnumerateRezArchives (then the bundled and support Plug-ins layers). DAT_00bec161 install flag not modelled.

name: ResourceArchive_OpenAllRezInNovaPlugins
comment: EnsureLoaded opens every sorted *.rez under <install>/Nova Plug-ins unconditionally (port has no licensing, matching a registered install), falling back to <install>/Plug-ins when Nova Plug-ins is absent (CE Mac-compat fallback, reconfirmed). It then loads the support folder's Nova Plug-ins/*.rez as the strongest layer (port extension). DAT_00bec160 not reproduced.

name: Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage
comment: PixPat decoder: validates patType 1, the PixMap rowBytes flag (0xc000==0x8000), bounds, zero resolution words and depth 1/2/4/8, unpacks MSB-first colour indices with a masked rowBytes stride, and maps the inline ColorTable (count entries, index at +0, RGB low byte at +3/+5/+7) into a 256-colour palette. src/pixpat_image.cpp Resource_LoadPixPatAsImage reproduces it and emits RGBA.

name: NovaUi_ScaleRectInPlace
comment: CE ui_scale helper: multiplies a QuickDraw rect's four shorts by g_ui_scale with x87 half-up rounding. No-op at scale 1.0; port has no ui_scale model.

name: Settings_LoadUiScale
comment: CE-only experimental UI scaling (CE src/scale-dlog.c, added 2023-10): reads ddraw.ini [EV Nova] ui_scale (default 1.0, 0 coerced to 1.0), sets g_ui_scale/_is_non_default and rescales five base UI metrics. Unported; the port has no ddraw.ini reader and fixes the HUD strip at 0xC2.

name: Dialog_CreateFromDlog
comment: Reads the DLOG (window bounds + linked DITL id; reimplemented as NovaResource_LoadDialogDefinition) and centres the window on screen (reimplemented as NovaDialogWindow_Layout); Marked 100%: the original global ui-scale canvas path is intentionally replaced; native dialog placement uses each authored composition and SDL placement owns containment and inverse input mapping.

name: PlayerTick_MouseCoordinateBridge
comment: INTERNAL LABEL of 0x0044AA70; not a function. Far bridge adjusts the saved cursor coordinate by the gameplay viewport offset and jumps to 0x0044E019; equivalent coordinate handling is folded into the reimplementation rather than ported one-to-one.
